fact: A University of Namibia honours study of traffic offence records in the Namibian Police in the Omusati region, interviewing 15 officers who manage crime records, found that the officers used manual records, created at the scene and stored in cabinet lockers, and recommended that the police fund and train for digitisation 'to kick off'.
title: Investigating the enhancement of traffic offence records management through digitisation in the Namibian police in the Omusati region
